'''Rolf''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, by c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], had became a member of a group of [[Believers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], under the command of [[Alina Impeveri]].

==Personality and traits==
Rolf viewed himself as a lover, but when in situations where there was no opportunity for him to make a new female aquaintance, or [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] through the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], he was happy to instead throw [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] at his enemies.
